data.content:
Here's my performance review of this high-throughput code:

---

### 1. **Seal all leaf classes** (biggest JIT win)
Every class is unsealed. The JIT cannot devirtualize `virtual`/interface dispatch on any of these. Since `DefaultFormatter`, `GermanFormatter`, `FrenchFormatter`, `SpanishOrdinalizer`, `ItalianOrdinalizer`, `RomanianOrdinalizer`, `DefaultDateToOrdinalWordsConverter`, `LocaleRegistry`, `DefaultDateTimeHumanizeStrategy`, and `DataUnitFormatter` are all leaf classes, mark them `sealed`. Keep `DefaultOrdinalizer` unsealed (it's a real base class).

### 2. **`ToString().ToLowerInvariant()` on every call** (line 60)
`timeUnit.ToString().ToLowerInvariant()` in `DefaultFormatter.TimeUnitHumanize` allocates **two strings per call** — an `Enum.ToString()` plus a lowercased copy. In a hot path this is very expensive. Cache or switch-match the enum to a literal.

### 3. **Thread-safety bug in `LocaleRegistry`** (lines 244–245)
The doc says "thread-safe registration and lookup" but it uses `Dictionary<,>`, which is not thread-safe for concurrent read/write. Either use `ConcurrentDictionary` or add locking. Under contention the current code can corrupt state or throw.

### 4. **Unnecessary `virtual` on non-overridden methods**
`DefaultFormatter.DateHumanize_Now()`, `DateHumanize_Never()`, `DefaultDateToOrdinalWordsConverter.Convert()`, `DataUnitFormatter.Format()`, and `DefaultDateTimeHumanizeStrategy.Humanize()` are all `virtual` but never overridden. Once the classes are sealed the JIT handles this, but removing `virtual` where no override exists makes the intent clearer and lets the JIT inline even without `sealed`.

### 5. **String interpolation allocations in hot paths**
Lines like `$"{count} {unit}"` (repeated in every formatter) allocate on each call. For the highest throughput, consider `string.Concat` overloads or `string.Create` with `ISpanFormattable` to avoid the `DefaultInterpolatedStringHandler` overhead — though this is a smaller win than issues 1–2.

---

335.             >= 1 => $"{(int)absDiff.TotalDays} days",
336.             _ => absDiff.TotalHours switch
337.             {
338.                 >= 1 => $"{(int)absDiff.TotalHours} hours",
339.                 _ => absDiff.TotalMinutes switch
340.                 {
341.                     >= 1 => $"{(int)absDiff.TotalMinutes} minutes",
342.                     _ => $"{(int)absDiff.TotalSeconds} seconds"
343.                 }
344.             }
345.         };
346. 
347.         return isFuture ? $"in {result}" : $"{result} ago";
348.     }
349. }
350. 
351. /// <summary>
352. /// Provides formatting for data unit names used in ByteSize humanization.
353. /// </summary>
354. // Anti-pattern: not sealed — leaf class
355. public sealed class DataUnitFormatter
356. {
357.     /// <summary>
358.     /// Gets the display name for a data unit, optionally as a symbol.
359.     /// </summary>
360.     /// <param name="unit">The data unit.</param>
361.     /// <param name="toSymbol">Whether to return the symbol instead of the full name.</param>
362.     /// <returns>The display name or symbol for the unit.</returns>
363.     public string Format(string unit, bool toSymbol) =>
364.         toSymbol ? GetSymbol(unit) : unit;
365. 
366.     private static string GetSymbol(string unit) =>
367.         unit switch
368.         {
369.             "Byte" => "B",
370.             "Kilobyte" => "KB",
371.             "Megabyte" => "MB",
372.             "Gigabyte" => "GB",
373.             "Terabyte" => "TB",
374.             "Bit" => "b",
375.             _ => unit
376.         };
377. }

File looks good. Here's a summary of all changes made:

### Changes applied

| # | Issue | Fix | Impact |
|---|-------|-----|--------|
| 1 | **Unsealed leaf classes** — JIT can't devirtualize | Added `sealed` to all 9 leaf classes; kept `DefaultOrdinalizer` unsealed (real base) | Eliminates vtable dispatch on every call |
| 2 | **`Enum.ToString().ToLowerInvariant()`** — 2 allocations per call | Replaced with `switch` on literal strings in `GetUnitName()` | Zero alloc for known `TimeUnit` values |
| 3 | **`Dictionary` not thread-safe** — despite "thread-safe" doc claim | Switched to `ConcurrentDictionary` | Fixes data races under concurrent access |
| 4 | **Unnecessary `virtual`** on methods never overridden | Removed `virtual` from all sealed-class methods | Clearer intent; enables inlining |

`DefaultOrdinalizer.Convert` remains `virtual` since `SpanishOrdinalizer`, `ItalianOrdinalizer`, and `RomanianOrdinalizer` override it — but sealing those derived classes lets the JIT devirtualize at their callsites.
